title: Comparing Intravitreal Injection Pain Scores Using Iheezo (Chloroprocaine Hcl Ophthalmic Gel 3%) Versus Subconjunctival Lidocaine (2%): A Randomized, Controlled Trial
official: Comparing Intravitreal Injection Pain Scores Using Iheezo (Chloroprocaine Hcl Ophthalmic Gel 3%) Versus Subconjunctival Lidocaine (2%): A Randomized, Controlled Trial
summary: This will be a prospective, randomized, controlled non-inferiority trial comparing the efficacy of Iheezo versus subconjunctival 2% lidocaine in reducing intravitreal injection pain scores up to 24 hours after injection.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 1 previous intravitreal injection in the last 180 days from screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of more than 13 intravitreal injections.
